name.cs: Pozdní doba bronzová (kolem 1100 př. n. l.)

note: Day rhythm is F (fiction): no source gives a daily schedule. Fractions run from midnight (0) through noon (0.5); sunrise is 0.25 and sunset 0.75 (core/day_clock.gd), so people wake before dawn, work in daylight and are home by dusk. Segments tile the day; the two sleep segments are one night across midnight.
